changelog: A submitted job is 'queued' until a worker thread really starts it (then 'running', with its start time). It used to be marked running straight away, so a job waiting behind busy slots showed Running · 0 % · no log (HTTP 404). A job cancelled while queued no longer starts later. Beta: a queued job says 'Waiting to start — every worker slot is busy' instead of the missing-log message. Backend part needs a restart (do it when no job is running).

previous.changelog: fix_emu_silva.sh: emu build-database copied the headerless taxonomy_list.tsv as it was — taxonomy.tsv came out with two columns (tax_id + one lineage string) and its first taxon taken as the header. The script now rewrites taxonomy.tsv with one column per rank (tax_id species genus family order class phylum superkingdom) from taxonomy_list.tsv, also on a database it built before. emu_pipeline refuses a database whose taxonomy.tsv has no genus/species column and points to the script. No backend restart needed.
